idea-plugin.name: Spacegray Dark Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Spacegray Dark Theme


Themes provide six styles (three standard + three Islands variants).

Standard Variants:
- Primary is the basic style of Dark theme based on JetBrains, and the UI area and editor are the same color.
- Pro is the basic style of Dark theme based on JetBrains, and the UI area and editor are different colors.
- SE is based on the basic dark blue of the original SpaceGray, and the UI area and the editor are different colors.

Islands Variants:
- Primary Islands, Pro Islands, and SE Islands provide modern floating UI design with rounded corners and elevated panels (IntelliJ 2025.3+).

主题提供了6种样式（3种标准 + 3种Islands变体）:

标准变体:
- Primary样式是基于Jetbrains Dark Theme基础UI样式，UI区和编辑器是相同的颜色。
- Pro样式是基于Jetbrains Dark Theme基础UI样式， UI区和编辑器是不相同的颜色。
- SE样式是基于原SpaceGray主题暗蓝色UI样式，UI区和编辑器是不相同的颜色.

Islands变体:
- Primary Islands、Pro Islands和SE Islands提供现代化的浮动UI设计，具有圆角和立体面板（IntelliJ 2025.3+）。


Spacegray theme for IntelliJ, inspired by one made by Gadzhi Kharkharov for SublimeText.
